verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows DeepInfra publishing a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. OpenAI-SDK compatibility is an adjacent feature: reusing OpenAI's spec would be a user-side workaround, not DeepInfra's own spec.
